hero.copy: A carefully curated iOS catalog, synced from official upstream releases every six hours — verified, health-checked and always installable.
hero.sourceHint: Add the source in your client

features.title: Everything a source needs.
features.discoveryText: Browse every upstream behind the catalog — maintainer, cadence, health and reputation on one page.
features.appsText: Filter 77+ apps by category, provenance, iOS version or sort order, with instant fuzzy search.
features.healthText: Downloads are probed every build; broken links open an issue before you ever tap Get.
features.verificationText: Origin, publisher and file hashes are checked end-to-end and labelled per app — never hidden.
features.collectionsText: Curated shelves for YouTube, music, emulators and utilities, updated with the catalog.
features.apiText: Versioned JSON endpoints, gzip twins and an AltStore-compatible feed — one URL to integrate.
